title: DAGR SRS verification execution record (frozen v0.1)
description: Execution metadata for one asserted ARCS Verify invocation: which receipt, trust bundle, verifier build, configuration, and report it bound together. Contains execution facts (execution_id, executed_at) that are deliberately absent from the deterministic report. Unknown fields fail closed: this schema defines no extension location.

execution_id.description: Opaque identifier for this asserted invocation. Execution metadata, not a deterministic verification result.

executed_at.description: Wall-clock time of this asserted invocation. Execution metadata, not a deterministic verification result.

verifier_commit.description: Full git commit SHA of the arcs-verify checkout that performed this invocation. Never a mutable ref.

verifier_configuration_digest.description: Must equal the paired verification report's verifier_configuration_digest.

receipt_id.description: Must equal the paired verification report's receipt_id.

receipt_artifact_hash.description: Must equal the paired verification report's receipt_artifact_hash.

trust_bundle_digest.description: Must equal the paired verification report's trust_bundle_digest.

verification_report_digest.description: sha256(RFC8785-JCS(complete deterministic verification report object)), lowercase hex, no prefix.

authentication_scope_statement.const: This execution record binds an asserted invocation to exact input and output artifacts. Standing alone, it does not authenticate who executed the verifier or authorize an export.
authentication_scope_statement.description: Fixed disclaimer. Standing alone, an execution record does not authenticate who executed the verifier or authorize an export; that belongs to a later, separate exporter contract.
